name: Staff member on the STAFF structure at Tk 38,750 plus a Tk 2,000 special allowance, provident fund at 7.5% and the last installment of a salary advance
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: MEDICAL = round(GROSS × 0.05) = round(38750 × 0.05) = round(1937.5) = 1938 (half rounds up)
SPECIAL = 2000 (a fixed amount on top of the structure)
Full month and attendance not tracked, so every line is paid in full; staff, not a worker, so no overtime
PF_EMPLOYER = round(23250 × 7.5 ÷ 100) = round(1743.75) = 1744 (an employer cost: not deducted from pay)
ADVANCE = min(outstanding 3500, installment 5000) = 3500, the last installment; pay left before it is 40750 − 1744 = 39006, enough
No salary tax in this case (no tax context is given, so the run does not work it out)
